exposure: digoxin treatment for fetal supraventricular tachycardia (SVT)
cohort: The study included 8 pregnant women in their 3rd trimester (mean age 33.0 years) treated for fetal supraventricular tachycardia (SVT).
finding: Pharmacokinetic parameters for digoxin showed a clear trend of increasing drug disposition in the third trimester of pregnancy, leading to recommended initial oral loading and maintenance doses.
